Changes.note: Selecting a request opens the deck’s sample cards, and that read is written to the audit log as a read of a private deck; when the page opens and when a request is answered, the next one is selected by itself. “Yayımla” opens the deck to everyone, visitors who are not signed in too, and its owner is notified. Whatever the owner changes later in its name, description and cards is published without a new review. “Reddet” keeps the deck private and sends the reason to its owner, who may ask again. “Yayından kaldır” is the Medaris başnazımı’s alone: it makes the deck private to its owner again, sends the reason and is written to the audit log. A Medaris nazımı cannot answer the request of his own deck.
